# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 19 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_019_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 19

**1** Jesus said: "Blessed is the one who came into being before coming into being.

**2** If you become my disciples and hear my words, these stones will minister to you.

**3** For you have five trees in Paradise that do not change in summer or winter, and their leaves do not fall.

**4** Whoever knows them will not taste death."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Came into being before coming into being" — the pre-existent divine self; one who knows their origin before birth
- "These stones will minister to you" — the material world (stones) becomes the servant of the initiated disciple
- "Five trees in Paradise" — a traditional image of the eternal realm; the number five may correspond to the five books of Moses, five senses, or five divine powers
- "Do not change" — permanent; not subject to cycles of change
- "Will not taste death" — the third echo of the collection's promise (Sayings 1, 18, 19)
